Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly estimated the density of bulk-packed iron nails as ~0.8 g/cm³. In reality, iron has a density of approximately 7.87 g/cm³, and even with packing inefficiencies (air gaps), the bulk density of iron nails would be significantly higher (likely >7 g/cm³), far exceeding the density of feathers (~1.3 g/cm³). Consequently, the calculation leading to the conclusion that feathers are heavier is fundamentally flawed due to this erroneous data input.
